birds.name: Sparrow

birds.name: Great tit

birds.name: Thrush

birds.name: Nightingale

birds.name: Skylark

birds.name: Swallow
birds.description: Fast aerial hunter of insects over water and fields.

birds.name: Woodpecker

birds.name: Magpie
birds.description: Smart black-and-white corvid, curious about everything.
